title: Chapter 108: Popular Version Of Biological Reproduction Equipment
content:
Chapter 108: Popular Version Of Biological Reproduction Equipment

Now that Wu Cong and the human wanderers are considered his own, there are some things that Wu Qing still wants to know about.

"Wucong, as far as I know, human wanderers are rarely captured. Did something happen to you?"

This question would have been difficult for Wu Qing to ask if Wu Cong and the others had not joined the Great Xia Territory. It doesn't matter if he asks now. Wu Qing really needs to know these things.

"We took a risk and took on a mission, but we fell into a trap!"

Wu never concealed anything, nor did he bring any personal emotions, and began to briefly describe the cause of the matter.

"It is said that human wanderers are carefree people. In fact, every human wanderer has his own story."

"Every person who chooses to become a human wanderer has his own reasons. They are just stronger than ordinary people and have one more choice!"

"The human wanderers composed of these people are also very unpopular in the native race camp."

"Our tribe of wanderers has been suppressed because we offended the great lord, and it has almost reached the point where we can no longer survive."

"In the end I had to take a risk and take on a dangerous mission."

"It turned out that this mission was a trap, and we were captured without any resistance."

"Fortunately, the other party spent a lot of money to lure us into the trap. Fortunately, we completed the task and gained a lot of luck."

"After we were captured, we kept moving around and no longer knew where we were."

"I didn't expect that my two thousand brothers and I would end up in the hands of the evil god's camp, and we almost became sacrifices to the evil god!"

"Death is not terrible, but being sacrificed to the evil god is hard for us to accept!"

"Perhaps the luck in the dark played a role, and we were lucky enough to meet the lord!"

"Rescue us from the evil god's camp, let us get rid of our previous fate and gain a new life!"

"Therefore, the kindness of the lord is far greater than the kindness of saving one's life!"

Wu Cong told some secrets that Wu Qing didn't know.

"It seems that the luck in the dark is indeed affecting the trajectory of destiny. You can be considered a successful self-rescue. I just happened to do it at the right time."

Wu Qing laughed and said, in order to prevent Wu Cong from continuing to talk about favors, he then asked: "You have changed hands from the native race camp to the evil god camp. Is there also a deal between the native race camp and the evil god camp?"

Wu Qing wanted to know this information.

"The composition of the local race camp is very complicated, and it can be said that there is a mixture of good and bad. Territories and races are constantly joining the evil god's camp, and there are also many powerful races who choose to escape from the world."

"In this context, the boundaries between camps are sometimes not so clearly drawn, especially with some chambers of commerce. It is very common for both sides to resell supplies."

"So, it's not surprising that we were resold to the evil god camp."

Wu Cong explained.

The two had an in-depth exchange of information, and Wu Qing obtained a lot of valuable information from Wu Cong.

…

During lunch time, Wu Qing stayed with Wu Cong to eat together.

There is no such thing as saying nothing while eating or sleeping. Wu Qing changed the topic and continued chatting with Wu Cong.

"Wucong, you are all combatants. Do you have your own ideas about your work after joining the Great Xia Territory?"

Wu Qing asked Wu Cong.

"Everyone is used to facing life and death, and we are willing to die on the battlefield. We are willing to continue fighting for the Great Xia Territory!"

Wu Cong's thoughts were as expected by Wu Qing. It was impossible for these human wanderers who licked blood from their swords to return to the mediocre lives of the territorial citizens.

Wu Qing wants to form an armed force outside of the Zerg tribe, and these human wanderers are the best choice.

But if Wu Cong and the others are no longer willing to fight around, Wu Qing will respect their opinions and let them return to a peaceful life and contribute in other jobs.

"Okay, I happen to also want to form an armed force other than the Zerg. You can join as the first batch of members!"

"I'm going to equip this unit with a special Zerg equipment. You can check it out first. After forming an army, everyone may need to adapt for a period of time."

"I'll let someone give you a demonstration first."

Wu Qing asked a bug guard to demonstrate the biological reproductive equipment for the witch slave on the spot.

When he saw the ever-changing biological equipment on the insect guards and used various unique combat skills to take advantage of the unique advantages of this equipment, the eyes of Wu Cong, who was extremely experienced in combat, kept gleaming.

"This is the biological breeding equipment of the Zerg. It is a biological equipment that can evolve. It can absorb energy and luck, continuously evolve, and improve its abilities in all aspects."

"It can proliferate and transform into a variety of weapons and armor according to the bound person's wishes to cope with various battlefield environments."

"My idea is that in the future, all the troops led by Daxia will be equipped with this kind of biological reproductive equipment. What do you think?"

Wu Qing personally explained the biological reproduction equipment of the Zerg to Wu Cong.

“Very amazing equipment!”

"Master the use of this set of equipment, and it will become a combat power multiplier for warriors!"

"I think we should dig deeper into its potential and use it as a basis to develop a unique set of fighting skills, and perhaps form a new fighting style!"

Wu Cong deserves to be the leader of the human wanderers, with extraordinary vision and similar ideas to Wu Qing.

The Zerg use the Zerg's fighting instinct to use biological colonization suits, which is a typical Zerg fighting style. The Zerg's fighting instinct is formed through the summary and chain of countless practical experience of the Zerg. It is extremely efficient and is the basic guarantee of the Zerg's terrifying combat power.

Wu Qing's understanding of the practice system of this world is not enough. What he sees most is the fighting on the battlefield, which are all simple battlefield moves, straight back and forth.

Seeing that Wu Cong is interested in this matter, Wu Qing wants to hand it over to Wu Cong.

"Wu Cong, since you have this idea, this matter will be handed over to you."

"You can take advantage of the opportunity of the army's new construction and start to adapt to the equipment, refer to some of the fighting skills of the Zerg and my personal guards, and refine a set of fighting skills suitable for the Daxia army."

"I will let the Zerg and the personal guards cooperate with you, is there any problem?"

Wu Qing said to Wu Cong.

"No problem! I will come up with a version as soon as possible!"

Wu Cong agreed very readily.

…

Now we need a large number of biological equipment, and the original customized production method that consumes a lot of resources is definitely not feasible. The resource consumption is too high, and Wu Qing can't afford it.

The popular version of biological equipment optimized by the queen came into being. The function of the optimized biological equipment remains unchanged, but the initial ability is much weaker, and the binder needs to provide energy and luck to evolve and upgrade.

In this way, a larva can produce 100 sets of biological equipment, and each set only consumes 10 energy points and 1 gas resource.
